A person can invoke the following GDPR articles after a chatbot gives incorrect information about them:

- Article 15 GDPR: Right to access, which allows individuals to obtain a copy of their personal data that are subject to processing.
- Article 16 GDPR: Right to rectification, which allows individuals to request the correction of inaccurate personal data.
- Article 17 GDPR: Right to erasure, which allows individuals to request the deletion of their personal data.
